exampleEn: I’d like to weigh in on the discussion about our project.
exampleKo: 나는 우리 프로젝트에 대한 논의에 참여하고 싶다.
gameExamples: Before we make a decision, I want to weigh in on the options available.
The professor encouraged all students to weigh in during the debate.
During the meeting, everyone had a chance to weigh in on the new policy changes.
